Safety and decision boundaries

A preparation tool—not a substitute for the responsible expert.

Urgent help comes first

Call 911 for immediate danger or a medical emergency. Call or text 988 for a mental-health or substance-use crisis. Stop driving a vehicle that may be unsafe.

You control the next step

Franklin Navigator prepares information on your device. It does not send, file, schedule, pay, authorize, diagnose, advise, rank or endorse.
